framework_metadata.description: Best known SGLang command for the benchmark repo default profile.
framework_metadata.notes: Keep this profile updated when the best command changes for a SGLang release or commit. Policy-aligned candidate (compile on, offload off) — NOT yet validated on H100; validate (incl. OOM risk) before publishing.

throughput_results.server_command: sglang serve --model-path Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Diffusers --port 30944 --host 127.0.0.1 --backend sglang --num-gpus 4 --model-type diffusion --warmup --enable-cfg-parallel --ulysses-degree 2 --dit-cpu-offload false --pin-cpu-memory --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed --enable-torch-compile --warmup-steps 3
